complaintDescription: Patient reported that her morning medication was delayed by more than 1 hour.
investigationSummary: Nursing Delay — Nurse assigned to the patient was attending an emergency case in the ICU, resulting in delayed medication administration. Backup nurse was not deployed due to improper shift planning.
correctiveAction: Deploy backup nurse — Assigned a backup nurse to ensure timely medication administration during peak hours. Doctor communication checklist — Instructed the doctor to follow the mandatory communication checklist during consultations.
